### Performance Improvements

- **admin:** add dedicated admin events endpoint ([38050df](https://github.com/palhinhax/Athlifyr/commit/38050df1147864fd9a3d02983416296ea8b00bb0))
- **admin:** optimize event search performance ([ee1ae5c](https://github.com/palhinhax/Athlifyr/commit/ee1ae5c279d583ca02022e2db97dbbb609d5207e))
- **api:** optimize event update endpoint to only modify changed data ([c0a61b4](https://github.com/palhinhax/Athlifyr/commit/c0a61b495d176365a427d5be242601bf6b67f74f))
- **instagram:** optimize video export with adaptive bitrate and FPS ([b4f568b](https://github.com/palhinhax/Athlifyr/commit/b4f568b2b1c854ebe79b41eab66c5edc6d89f09c))
- **mobile:** optimize map screen to prevent refetching on every mount ([48a3dea](https://github.com/palhinhax/Athlifyr/commit/48a3dea38f65391b0cdab12eef2a4341773b9014))

### BREAKING CHANGES

- **auth:** API routes now require NextRequest parameter instead of Request.
  All authenticated endpoints now use unified auth helper.
- **auth:** All existing emails in database are normalized to lowercase.
  New unique index on LOWER(email) prevents case-sensitive duplicates at database level.

* Add case-insensitive email duplicate check in register endpoint
* Normalize emails to lowercase in login and register (web + mobile)
* Add email normalization in Google OAuth callback
* Clear mobile auth tokens before re-registration
* Create database script to add unique index on LOWER(email)
* Update mobile auth store to normalize emails on login

Closes issue with users creating multiple accounts with same email (different casing).

- **i18n:** site.webmanifest now served dynamically via route handler only
- **i18n:** Training plans now require translations in database. Existing plans without translations will need to be migrated.
- **workouts:** Performance entries now only created for exercises with hasWeight=true. Running, burpees, and other bodyweight exercises no longer tracked in strength performance section.
- **db:** StrengthExercise renamed to Exercise. Database migration required.
- **performance:** None - existing RUN entries remain unchanged, only new trail
  events will be classified as TRAIL type.
- **chat:** Socket.IO is no longer used. The custom server.ts
  is removed - use standard 'next start' for production.
- **events:** completionTime field changed from String to Int.
  All existing completion times will be lost during migration.
- **venues:** VenuePlan.paymentProvider field removed. Payment processing now managed at venue level via Venue.paymentMode (IN_APP, EXTERNAL, MIXED).

* Add Stripe Connect onboarding and payment processing for venues
* Create database migration for guest bookings support
* Add Stripe webhook handling for account updates
* Implement venue commission system (PERCENT/FIXED types)
* Add fee management API endpoint and UI dialog (admin only)
* Refactor admin venues page into 5 modular components
* Create venue cards, dialogs for create/owner/fees management
* Add 2 new event seeds: Trail do Vale + Tribal Clash Portugal
* Fix translation structure: move weather inside events namespace
* Fix unused variable ESLint error in image-upload component

New Stripe features:
Venue owner Stripe Connect onboarding
Platform commission configuration per venue
Automated payment splitting
Webhook sync for account status

New admin features:
Fee management modal for venue commissions
Owner assignment dialog with user search
Modular component architecture (195 vs 883 lines)

Database changes:
Guest booking support (userId optional)
PaymentsProvider enum (NONE, STRIPE)
StripeOnboardingStatus tracking
Commission fields (commissionType, commissionValue)
StripeWebhookEvent tracking table

Event seeds:
Trail do Vale 2026 (Tomar, 17 May)
Tribal Clash Portugal 2026 (Vilamoura, 2-3 May)
Complete translations for all 6 languages
SEO metadata with metaTitle/metaDescription
FAQs in all languages

Code quality:
pnpm format passed
ESLint passed (2 warnings only - <img> tags)
TypeScript typecheck passed
All changes follow conventional commits
Documentation created for refactoring

- **seo:** None - improves SEO without breaking existing functionality
- **instagram:** Weather system requires new environment variables:

* OPENWEATHER_API_KEY: API key from openweathermap.org (free tier supported)
* WEATHER_UPDATE_SECRET: Security token for automated updates (generate with openssl rand -hex 32)

Migration required: pnpm prisma migrate dev --name add-event-weather

- **sports:** Events with walking variants should now use WALKING category instead of RUNNING
- **seeds:** Seed files moved from prisma/ to prisma/seeds/ directory.
  Update execution commands to use prisma/seeds/<file>.ts path.
- **instagram:** Database schema updated with new venue and booking models
- **events:** Events page now shows all future events regardless of country by default, instead of filtering by user's country. Users can enable location-based filtering explicitly.
- Seed file relocated from prisma/seed-trail-santa-iria.ts to prisma/seeds/trail-santa-iria-2026.ts

* Move seed file to prisma/seeds/ directory (proper location)
* Remove nested create operations for full idempotency
* Use separate upsert operations for event, translations, variants, and pricing phases
* Add translations for all 6 supported languages (pt, en, es, fr, de, it)
* Add imageUrl field set to empty string
* Add variant translations for all languages
* Safe for execution on shared database environments

Co-authored-by: palhinhax <13228131+palhinhax@users.noreply.github.com>

- **events:** Removed dateRange filter parameter from events API and preferences

  All existing routes have been moved under [locale] folder structure.
- **contact:** New database table Contact requires migration
- **events:** Event model now uses sportTypes[] instead of sportType.
  All existing events automatically migrated to array format.

* Update EventCard to display multiple sport badges

### BREAKING CHANGES

- **auth:** API routes now require NextRequest parameter instead of Request.
  All authenticated endpoints now use unified auth helper.
- **auth:** All existing emails in database are normalized to lowercase.
  New unique index on LOWER(email) prevents case-sensitive duplicates at database level.

* Add case-insensitive email duplicate check in register endpoint
* Normalize emails to lowercase in login and register (web + mobile)
* Add email normalization in Google OAuth callback
* Clear mobile auth tokens before re-registration
* Create database script to add unique index on LOWER(email)
* Update mobile auth store to normalize emails on login

Closes issue with users creating multiple accounts with same email (different casing).

- **i18n:** site.webmanifest now served dynamically via route handler only
- **i18n:** Training plans now require translations in database. Existing plans without translations will need to be migrated.
- **workouts:** Performance entries now only created for exercises with hasWeight=true. Running, burpees, and other bodyweight exercises no longer tracked in strength performance section.
- **db:** StrengthExercise renamed to Exercise. Database migration required.
- **performance:** None - existing RUN entries remain unchanged, only new trail
  events will be classified as TRAIL type.
- **chat:** Socket.IO is no longer used. The custom server.ts
  is removed - use standard 'next start' for production.
- **events:** completionTime field changed from String to Int.
  All existing completion times will be lost during migration.
- **venues:** VenuePlan.paymentProvider field removed. Payment processing now managed at venue level via Venue.paymentMode (IN_APP, EXTERNAL, MIXED).

* Add Stripe Connect onboarding and payment processing for venues
* Create database migration for guest bookings support
* Add Stripe webhook handling for account updates
* Implement venue commission system (PERCENT/FIXED types)
* Add fee management API endpoint and UI dialog (admin only)
* Refactor admin venues page into 5 modular components
* Create venue cards, dialogs for create/owner/fees management
* Add 2 new event seeds: Trail do Vale + Tribal Clash Portugal
* Fix translation structure: move weather inside events namespace
* Fix unused variable ESLint error in image-upload component

New Stripe features:
Venue owner Stripe Connect onboarding
Platform commission configuration per venue
Automated payment splitting
Webhook sync for account status

New admin features:
Fee management modal for venue commissions
Owner assignment dialog with user search
Modular component architecture (195 vs 883 lines)

Database changes:
Guest booking support (userId optional)
PaymentsProvider enum (NONE, STRIPE)
StripeOnboardingStatus tracking
Commission fields (commissionType, commissionValue)
StripeWebhookEvent tracking table

Event seeds:
Trail do Vale 2026 (Tomar, 17 May)
Tribal Clash Portugal 2026 (Vilamoura, 2-3 May)
Complete translations for all 6 languages
SEO metadata with metaTitle/metaDescription
FAQs in all languages

Code quality:
pnpm format passed
ESLint passed (2 warnings only - <img> tags)
TypeScript typecheck passed
All changes follow conventional commits
Documentation created for refactoring

- **seo:** None - improves SEO without breaking existing functionality
- **instagram:** Weather system requires new environment variables:

* OPENWEATHER_API_KEY: API key from openweathermap.org (free tier supported)
* WEATHER_UPDATE_SECRET: Security token for automated updates (generate with openssl rand -hex 32)

Migration required: pnpm prisma migrate dev --name add-event-weather

- **sports:** Events with walking variants should now use WALKING category instead of RUNNING
- **seeds:** Seed files moved from prisma/ to prisma/seeds/ directory.
  Update execution commands to use prisma/seeds/<file>.ts path.
- **instagram:** Database schema updated with new venue and booking models
- **events:** Events page now shows all future events regardless of country by default, instead of filtering by user's country. Users can enable location-based filtering explicitly.
- Seed file relocated from prisma/seed-trail-santa-iria.ts to prisma/seeds/trail-santa-iria-2026.ts

* Move seed file to prisma/seeds/ directory (proper location)
* Remove nested create operations for full idempotency
* Use separate upsert operations for event, translations, variants, and pricing phases
* Add translations for all 6 supported languages (pt, en, es, fr, de, it)
* Add imageUrl field set to empty string
* Add variant translations for all languages
* Safe for execution on shared database environments

  All existing routes have been moved under [locale] folder structure.

  All existing events automatically migrated to array format.

- **instagram:** optimize video export with adaptive bitrate and FPS ([b4f568b](https://github.com/palhinhax/Athlifyr/commit/b4f568b2b1c854ebe79b41eab66c5edc6d89f09c))
- **mobile:** optimize map screen to prevent refetching on every mount ([48a3dea](https://github.com/palhinhax/Athlifyr/commit/48a3dea38f65391b0cdab12eef2a4341773b9014))

### BREAKING CHANGES

- **auth:** API routes now require NextRequest parameter instead of Request.
  All authenticated endpoints now use unified auth helper.
- **auth:** All existing emails in database are normalized to lowercase.
  New unique index on LOWER(email) prevents case-sensitive duplicates at database level.

* Add case-insensitive email duplicate check in register endpoint
* Normalize emails to lowercase in login and register (web + mobile)
* Add email normalization in Google OAuth callback
* Clear mobile auth tokens before re-registration
* Create database script to add unique index on LOWER(email)
* Update mobile auth store to normalize emails on login

Closes issue with users creating multiple accounts with same email (different casing).

- **i18n:** site.webmanifest now served dynamically via route handler only
- **i18n:** Training plans now require translations in database. Existing plans without translations will need to be migrated.
- **workouts:** Performance entries now only created for exercises with hasWeight=true. Running, burpees, and other bodyweight exercises no longer tracked in strength performance section.
- **db:** StrengthExercise renamed to Exercise. Database migration required.
- **performance:** None - existing RUN entries remain unchanged, only new trail
  events will be classified as TRAIL type.
- **chat:** Socket.IO is no longer used. The custom server.ts
  is removed - use standard 'next start' for production.
- **events:** completionTime field changed from String to Int.
  All existing completion times will be lost during migration.
- **venues:** VenuePlan.paymentProvider field removed. Payment processing now managed at venue level via Venue.paymentMode (IN_APP, EXTERNAL, MIXED).

* Add Stripe Connect onboarding and payment processing for venues
* Create database migration for guest bookings support
* Add Stripe webhook handling for account updates
* Implement venue commission system (PERCENT/FIXED types)
* Add fee management API endpoint and UI dialog (admin only)
* Refactor admin venues page into 5 modular components
* Create venue cards, dialogs for create/owner/fees management
* Add 2 new event seeds: Trail do Vale + Tribal Clash Portugal
* Fix translation structure: move weather inside events namespace
* Fix unused variable ESLint error in image-upload component

New Stripe features:
Venue owner Stripe Connect onboarding
Platform commission configuration per venue
Automated payment splitting
Webhook sync for account status

New admin features:
Fee management modal for venue commissions
Owner assignment dialog with user search
Modular component architecture (195 vs 883 lines)

Database changes:
Guest booking support (userId optional)
PaymentsProvider enum (NONE, STRIPE)
StripeOnboardingStatus tracking
Commission fields (commissionType, commissionValue)
StripeWebhookEvent tracking table

Event seeds:
Trail do Vale 2026 (Tomar, 17 May)
Tribal Clash Portugal 2026 (Vilamoura, 2-3 May)
Complete translations for all 6 languages
SEO metadata with metaTitle/metaDescription
FAQs in all languages

Code quality:
pnpm format passed
ESLint passed (2 warnings only - <img> tags)
TypeScript typecheck passed
All changes follow conventional commits
Documentation created for refactoring

- **seo:** None - improves SEO without breaking existing functionality
- **instagram:** Weather system requires new environment variables:

* OPENWEATHER_API_KEY: API key from openweathermap.org (free tier supported)
* WEATHER_UPDATE_SECRET: Security token for automated updates (generate with openssl rand -hex 32)

Migration required: pnpm prisma migrate dev --name add-event-weather

- **sports:** Events with walking variants should now use WALKING category instead of RUNNING
- **seeds:** Seed files moved from prisma/ to prisma/seeds/ directory.
  Update execution commands to use prisma/seeds/<file>.ts path.
- **instagram:** Database schema updated with new venue and booking models
- **events:** Events page now shows all future events regardless of country by default, instead of filtering by user's country. Users can enable location-based filtering explicitly.
- Seed file relocated from prisma/seed-trail-santa-iria.ts to prisma/seeds/trail-santa-iria-2026.ts

* Move seed file to prisma/seeds/ directory (proper location)
* Remove nested create operations for full idempotency
* Use separate upsert operations for event, translations, variants, and pricing phases
* Add translations for all 6 supported languages (pt, en, es, fr, de, it)
* Add imageUrl field set to empty string
* Add variant translations for all languages
* Safe for execution on shared database environments

Co-authored-by: palhinhax <13228131+palhinhax@users.noreply.github.com>

- **events:** Removed dateRange filter parameter from events API and preferences

  All existing routes have been moved under [locale] folder structure.
- **contact:** New database table Contact requires migration
- **events:** Event model now uses sportTypes[] instead of sportType.
  All existing events automatically migrated to array format.

- **instagram:** optimize video export with adaptive bitrate and FPS ([b4f568b](https://github.com/palhinhax/Athlifyr/commit/b4f568b2b1c854ebe79b41eab66c5edc6d89f09c))
- **mobile:** optimize map screen to prevent refetching on every mount ([48a3dea](https://github.com/palhinhax/Athlifyr/commit/48a3dea38f65391b0cdab12eef2a4341773b9014))

### BREAKING CHANGES

- **auth:** API routes now require NextRequest parameter instead of Request.
  All authenticated endpoints now use unified auth helper.
- **auth:** All existing emails in database are normalized to lowercase.
  New unique index on LOWER(email) prevents case-sensitive duplicates at database level.

* Add case-insensitive email duplicate check in register endpoint
* Normalize emails to lowercase in login and register (web + mobile)
* Add email normalization in Google OAuth callback
* Clear mobile auth tokens before re-registration
* Create database script to add unique index on LOWER(email)
* Update mobile auth store to normalize emails on login

Closes issue with users creating multiple accounts with same email (different casing).

- **i18n:** site.webmanifest now served dynamically via route handler only
- **i18n:** Training plans now require translations in database. Existing plans without translations will need to be migrated.
- **workouts:** Performance entries now only created for exercises with hasWeight=true. Running, burpees, and other bodyweight exercises no longer tracked in strength performance section.
- **db:** StrengthExercise renamed to Exercise. Database migration required.
- **performance:** None - existing RUN entries remain unchanged, only new trail
  events will be classified as TRAIL type.
- **chat:** Socket.IO is no longer used. The custom server.ts
  is removed - use standard 'next start' for production.
- **events:** completionTime field changed from String to Int.
  All existing completion times will be lost during migration.
- **venues:** VenuePlan.paymentProvider field removed. Payment processing now managed at venue level via Venue.paymentMode (IN_APP, EXTERNAL, MIXED).

* Add Stripe Connect onboarding and payment processing for venues
* Create database migration for guest bookings support
* Add Stripe webhook handling for account updates
* Implement venue commission system (PERCENT/FIXED types)
* Add fee management API endpoint and UI dialog (admin only)
* Refactor admin venues page into 5 modular components
* Create venue cards, dialogs for create/owner/fees management
* Add 2 new event seeds: Trail do Vale + Tribal Clash Portugal
* Fix translation structure: move weather inside events namespace
* Fix unused variable ESLint error in image-upload component

New Stripe features:
Venue owner Stripe Connect onboarding
Platform commission configuration per venue
Automated payment splitting
Webhook sync for account status

New admin features:
Fee management modal for venue commissions
Owner assignment dialog with user search
Modular component architecture (195 vs 883 lines)

Database changes:
Guest booking support (userId optional)
PaymentsProvider enum (NONE, STRIPE)
StripeOnboardingStatus tracking
Commission fields (commissionType, commissionValue)
StripeWebhookEvent tracking table

Event seeds:
Trail do Vale 2026 (Tomar, 17 May)
Tribal Clash Portugal 2026 (Vilamoura, 2-3 May)
Complete translations for all 6 languages
SEO metadata with metaTitle/metaDescription
FAQs in all languages

Code quality:
pnpm format passed
ESLint passed (2 warnings only - <img> tags)
TypeScript typecheck passed
All changes follow conventional commits
Documentation created for refactoring

- **seo:** None - improves SEO without breaking existing functionality
- **instagram:** Weather system requires new environment variables:

* OPENWEATHER_API_KEY: API key from openweathermap.org (free tier supported)
* WEATHER_UPDATE_SECRET: Security token for automated updates (generate with openssl rand -hex 32)

Migration required: pnpm prisma migrate dev --name add-event-weather

- **sports:** Events with walking variants should now use WALKING category instead of RUNNING
- **seeds:** Seed files moved from prisma/ to prisma/seeds/ directory.
  Update execution commands to use prisma/seeds/<file>.ts path.
- **instagram:** Database schema updated with new venue and booking models
- **events:** Events page now shows all future events regardless of country by default, instead of filtering by user's country. Users can enable location-based filtering explicitly.
- Seed file relocated from prisma/seed-trail-santa-iria.ts to prisma/seeds/trail-santa-iria-2026.ts

* Move seed file to prisma/seeds/ directory (proper location)
* Remove nested create operations for full idempotency
* Use separate upsert operations for event, translations, variants, and pricing phases
* Add translations for all 6 supported languages (pt, en, es, fr, de, it)
* Add imageUrl field set to empty string
* Add variant translations for all languages
* Safe for execution on shared database environments

Co-authored-by: palhinhax <13228131+palhinhax@users.noreply.github.com>

- **events:** Removed dateRange filter parameter from events API and preferences

  All existing routes have been moved under [locale] folder structure.
- **contact:** New database table Contact requires migration
- **events:** Event model now uses sportTypes[] instead of sportType.
  All existing events automatically migrated to array format.

- **mobile:** optimize map screen to prevent refetching on every mount ([48a3dea](https://github.com/palhinhax/Athlifyr/commit/48a3dea38f65391b0cdab12eef2a4341773b9014))

### BREAKING CHANGES

- **auth:** All existing emails in database are normalized to lowercase.
  New unique index on LOWER(email) prevents case-sensitive duplicates at database level.

* Add case-insensitive email duplicate check in register endpoint
* Normalize emails to lowercase in login and register (web + mobile)
* Add email normalization in Google OAuth callback
* Clear mobile auth tokens before re-registration
* Create database script to add unique index on LOWER(email)
* Update mobile auth store to normalize emails on login

Closes issue with users creating multiple accounts with same email (different casing).

- **i18n:** site.webmanifest now served dynamically via route handler only
- **i18n:** Training plans now require translations in database. Existing plans without translations will need to be migrated.
- **workouts:** Performance entries now only created for exercises with hasWeight=true. Running, burpees, and other bodyweight exercises no longer tracked in strength performance section.
- **db:** StrengthExercise renamed to Exercise. Database migration required.
- **performance:** None - existing RUN entries remain unchanged, only new trail
  events will be classified as TRAIL type.
- **chat:** Socket.IO is no longer used. The custom server.ts
  is removed - use standard 'next start' for production.
- **events:** completionTime field changed from String to Int.
  All existing completion times will be lost during migration.
- **venues:** VenuePlan.paymentProvider field removed. Payment processing now managed at venue level via Venue.paymentMode (IN_APP, EXTERNAL, MIXED).

* Add Stripe Connect onboarding and payment processing for venues
* Create database migration for guest bookings support
* Add Stripe webhook handling for account updates
* Implement venue commission system (PERCENT/FIXED types)
* Add fee management API endpoint and UI dialog (admin only)
* Refactor admin venues page into 5 modular components
* Create venue cards, dialogs for create/owner/fees management
* Add 2 new event seeds: Trail do Vale + Tribal Clash Portugal
* Fix translation structure: move weather inside events namespace
* Fix unused variable ESLint error in image-upload component

New Stripe features:
Venue owner Stripe Connect onboarding
Platform commission configuration per venue
Automated payment splitting
Webhook sync for account status

New admin features:
Fee management modal for venue commissions
Owner assignment dialog with user search
Modular component architecture (195 vs 883 lines)

Database changes:
Guest booking support (userId optional)
PaymentsProvider enum (NONE, STRIPE)
StripeOnboardingStatus tracking
Commission fields (commissionType, commissionValue)
StripeWebhookEvent tracking table

Event seeds:
Trail do Vale 2026 (Tomar, 17 May)
Tribal Clash Portugal 2026 (Vilamoura, 2-3 May)
Complete translations for all 6 languages
SEO metadata with metaTitle/metaDescription
FAQs in all languages

Code quality:
pnpm format passed
ESLint passed (2 warnings only - <img> tags)
TypeScript typecheck passed
All changes follow conventional commits
Documentation created for refactoring

- **seo:** None - improves SEO without breaking existing functionality
- **instagram:** Weather system requires new environment variables:

* OPENWEATHER_API_KEY: API key from openweathermap.org (free tier supported)
* WEATHER_UPDATE_SECRET: Security token for automated updates (generate with openssl rand -hex 32)

Migration required: pnpm prisma migrate dev --name add-event-weather

- **sports:** Events with walking variants should now use WALKING category instead of RUNNING
- **seeds:** Seed files moved from prisma/ to prisma/seeds/ directory.
  Update execution commands to use prisma/seeds/<file>.ts path.
- **instagram:** Database schema updated with new venue and booking models
- **events:** Events page now shows all future events regardless of country by default, instead of filtering by user's country. Users can enable location-based filtering explicitly.
- Seed file relocated from prisma/seed-trail-santa-iria.ts to prisma/seeds/trail-santa-iria-2026.ts

* Move seed file to prisma/seeds/ directory (proper location)
* Remove nested create operations for full idempotency
* Use separate upsert operations for event, translations, variants, and pricing phases
* Add translations for all 6 supported languages (pt, en, es, fr, de, it)
* Add imageUrl field set to empty string
* Add variant translations for all languages
* Safe for execution on shared database environments

Co-authored-by: palhinhax <13228131+palhinhax@users.noreply.github.com>

- **events:** Removed dateRange filter parameter from events API and preferences
- **i18n:** Application now requires locale in URL paths (e.g., /pt/events, /en/events).
  All existing routes have been moved under [locale] folder structure.
- **contact:** New database table Contact requires migration
- **events:** Event model now uses sportTypes[] instead of sportType.
  All existing events automatically migrated to array format.

* Add sportTypes array to Event model for multi-sport events
* Add PricingPhase model for complex pricing structures
* Add technical fields to EventVariant (cutoffTimeHours, elevationGainM, etc.)
* Add registrationDeadline to Event model
* Add favoriteSports to User model
* Add CollapsibleDescription component for long event descriptions
* Add EventPricingPhases component for displaying pricing timelines
* Update EventVariantTechnicalData with proper data display
* Update all seed files to use sportTypes array format

* Create Trail/BTT Serras do Minho as first dual-modality event
* Create complete seeds for 7 additional janeiro events
* Update all application code to query sportTypes arrays
* Update EventCard to display multiple sport badges
* Migration preserves all existing event data safely
* All TypeScript types updated and verified
* Build passes with zero errors

### Performance Improvements

- **admin:** add dedicated admin events endpoint ([38050df](https://github.com/palhinhax/Athlifyr/commit/38050df1147864fd9a3d02983416296ea8b00bb0))
- **admin:** optimize event search performance ([ee1ae5c](https://github.com/palhinhax/Athlifyr/commit/ee1ae5c279d583ca02022e2db97dbbb609d5207e))

- **instagram:** optimize video export with adaptive bitrate and FPS ([b4f568b](https://github.com/palhinhax/Athlifyr/commit/b4f568b2b1c854ebe79b41eab66c5edc6d89f09c))

### BREAKING CHANGES

- **i18n:** site.webmanifest now served dynamically via route handler only
- **i18n:** Training plans now require translations in database. Existing plans without translations will need to be migrated.
- **workouts:** Performance entries now only created for exercises with hasWeight=true. Running, burpees, and other bodyweight exercises no longer tracked in strength performance section.
- **db:** StrengthExercise renamed to Exercise. Database migration required.
- **performance:** None - existing RUN entries remain unchanged, only new trail
  events will be classified as TRAIL type.
- **chat:** Socket.IO is no longer used. The custom server.ts
  is removed - use standard 'next start' for production.
- **events:** completionTime field changed from String to Int.
  All existing completion times will be lost during migration.
- **venues:** VenuePlan.paymentProvider field removed. Payment processing now managed at venue level via Venue.paymentMode (IN_APP, EXTERNAL, MIXED).

* Add Stripe Connect onboarding and payment processing for venues
* Create database migration for guest bookings support
* Add Stripe webhook handling for account updates
* Implement venue commission system (PERCENT/FIXED types)
* Add fee management API endpoint and UI dialog (admin only)
* Refactor admin venues page into 5 modular components
* Create venue cards, dialogs for create/owner/fees management
* Add 2 new event seeds: Trail do Vale + Tribal Clash Portugal
* Fix translation structure: move weather inside events namespace
* Fix unused variable ESLint error in image-upload component

New Stripe features:
Venue owner Stripe Connect onboarding
Platform commission configuration per venue
Automated payment splitting
Webhook sync for account status

New admin features:
Fee management modal for venue commissions
Owner assignment dialog with user search
Modular component architecture (195 vs 883 lines)

Database changes:
Guest booking support (userId optional)
PaymentsProvider enum (NONE, STRIPE)
StripeOnboardingStatus tracking
Commission fields (commissionType, commissionValue)
StripeWebhookEvent tracking table

Event seeds:
Trail do Vale 2026 (Tomar, 17 May)
Tribal Clash Portugal 2026 (Vilamoura, 2-3 May)
Complete translations for all 6 languages
SEO metadata with metaTitle/metaDescription
FAQs in all languages

Code quality:
pnpm format passed
ESLint passed (2 warnings only - <img> tags)
TypeScript typecheck passed
All changes follow conventional commits
Documentation created for refactoring

- **seo:** None - improves SEO without breaking existing functionality
- **instagram:** Weather system requires new environment variables:

* OPENWEATHER_API_KEY: API key from openweathermap.org (free tier supported)
* WEATHER_UPDATE_SECRET: Security token for automated updates (generate with openssl rand -hex 32)

Migration required: pnpm prisma migrate dev --name add-event-weather

- **sports:** Events with walking variants should now use WALKING category instead of RUNNING
- **seeds:** Seed files moved from prisma/ to prisma/seeds/ directory.
  Update execution commands to use prisma/seeds/<file>.ts path.
- **instagram:** Database schema updated with new venue and booking models
- **events:** Events page now shows all future events regardless of country by default, instead of filtering by user's country. Users can enable location-based filtering explicitly.
- Seed file relocated from prisma/seed-trail-santa-iria.ts to prisma/seeds/trail-santa-iria-2026.ts

* Move seed file to prisma/seeds/ directory (proper location)
* Remove nested create operations for full idempotency
* Use separate upsert operations for event, translations, variants, and pricing phases
* Add translations for all 6 supported languages (pt, en, es, fr, de, it)
* Add imageUrl field set to empty string
* Add variant translations for all languages
* Safe for execution on shared database environments

Co-authored-by: palhinhax <13228131+palhinhax@users.noreply.github.com>

- **events:** Removed dateRange filter parameter from events API and preferences
- **i18n:** Application now requires locale in URL paths (e.g., /pt/events, /en/events).
  All existing routes have been moved under [locale] folder structure.
- **contact:** New database table Contact requires migration
- **events:** Event model now uses sportTypes[] instead of sportType.
  All existing events automatically migrated to array format.

* Add sportTypes array to Event model for multi-sport events
* Add PricingPhase model for complex pricing structures
* Add technical fields to EventVariant (cutoffTimeHours, elevationGainM, etc.)
* Add registrationDeadline to Event model
* Add favoriteSports to User model
* Add CollapsibleDescription component for long event descriptions
* Add EventPricingPhases component for displaying pricing timelines
* Update EventVariantTechnicalData with proper data display
* Update all seed files to use sportTypes array format

* Create Trail/BTT Serras do Minho as first dual-modality event
* Create complete seeds for 7 additional janeiro events
* Update all application code to query sportTypes arrays
* Update EventCard to display multiple sport badges
* Migration preserves all existing event data safely
* All TypeScript types updated and verified
* Build passes with zero errors

- **instagram:** optimize video export with adaptive bitrate and FPS ([b4f568b](https://github.com/palhinhax/Athlifyr/commit/b4f568b2b1c854ebe79b41eab66c5edc6d89f09c))

### BREAKING CHANGES

- **i18n:** site.webmanifest now served dynamically via route handler only
- **i18n:** Training plans now require translations in database. Existing plans without translations will need to be migrated.
- **workouts:** Performance entries now only created for exercises with hasWeight=true. Running, burpees, and other bodyweight exercises no longer tracked in strength performance section.
- **db:** StrengthExercise renamed to Exercise. Database migration required.
- **performance:** None - existing RUN entries remain unchanged, only new trail
  events will be classified as TRAIL type.
- **chat:** Socket.IO is no longer used. The custom server.ts
  is removed - use standard 'next start' for production.
- **events:** completionTime field changed from String to Int.
  All existing completion times will be lost during migration.
- **venues:** VenuePlan.paymentProvider field removed. Payment processing now managed at venue level via Venue.paymentMode (IN_APP, EXTERNAL, MIXED).

* Add Stripe Connect onboarding and payment processing for venues
* Create database migration for guest bookings support
* Add Stripe webhook handling for account updates
* Implement venue commission system (PERCENT/FIXED types)
* Add fee management API endpoint and UI dialog (admin only)
* Refactor admin venues page into 5 modular components
* Create venue cards, dialogs for create/owner/fees management
* Add 2 new event seeds: Trail do Vale + Tribal Clash Portugal
* Fix translation structure: move weather inside events namespace
* Fix unused variable ESLint error in image-upload component

New Stripe features:
Venue owner Stripe Connect onboarding
Platform commission configuration per venue
Automated payment splitting
Webhook sync for account status

New admin features:
Fee management modal for venue commissions
Owner assignment dialog with user search
Modular component architecture (195 vs 883 lines)

Database changes:
Guest booking support (userId optional)
PaymentsProvider enum (NONE, STRIPE)
StripeOnboardingStatus tracking
Commission fields (commissionType, commissionValue)
StripeWebhookEvent tracking table

Event seeds:
Trail do Vale 2026 (Tomar, 17 May)
Tribal Clash Portugal 2026 (Vilamoura, 2-3 May)
Complete translations for all 6 languages
SEO metadata with metaTitle/metaDescription
FAQs in all languages

Code quality:
pnpm format passed
ESLint passed (2 warnings only - <img> tags)
TypeScript typecheck passed
All changes follow conventional commits
Documentation created for refactoring

- **seo:** None - improves SEO without breaking existing functionality
- **instagram:** Weather system requires new environment variables:

* OPENWEATHER_API_KEY: API key from openweathermap.org (free tier supported)
* WEATHER_UPDATE_SECRET: Security token for automated updates (generate with openssl rand -hex 32)

Migration required: pnpm prisma migrate dev --name add-event-weather

- **sports:** Events with walking variants should now use WALKING category instead of RUNNING
- **seeds:** Seed files moved from prisma/ to prisma/seeds/ directory.
  Update execution commands to use prisma/seeds/<file>.ts path.
- **instagram:** Database schema updated with new venue and booking models
- **events:** Events page now shows all future events regardless of country by default, instead of filtering by user's country. Users can enable location-based filtering explicitly.
- Seed file relocated from prisma/seed-trail-santa-iria.ts to prisma/seeds/trail-santa-iria-2026.ts

* Move seed file to prisma/seeds/ directory (proper location)
* Remove nested create operations for full idempotency
* Use separate upsert operations for event, translations, variants, and pricing phases
* Add translations for all 6 supported languages (pt, en, es, fr, de, it)
* Add imageUrl field set to empty string
* Add variant translations for all languages
* Safe for execution on shared database environments

Co-authored-by: palhinhax <13228131+palhinhax@users.noreply.github.com>

- **events:** Removed dateRange filter parameter from events API and preferences
- **i18n:** Application now requires locale in URL paths (e.g., /pt/events, /en/events).
  All existing routes have been moved under [locale] folder structure.
- **contact:** New database table Contact requires migration
- **events:** Event model now uses sportTypes[] instead of sportType.
  All existing events automatically migrated to array format.

* Update EventCard to display multiple sport badges

* Build passes with zero errors

### Performance Improvements

- **admin:** add dedicated admin events endpoint ([38050df](https://github.com/palhinhax/Athlifyr/commit/38050df1147864fd9a3d02983416296ea8b00bb0))
- **admin:** optimize event search performance ([ee1ae5c](https://github.com/palhinhax/Athlifyr/commit/ee1ae5c279d583ca02022e2db97dbbb609d5207e))
- **api:** optimize event update endpoint to only modify changed data ([c0a61b4](https://github.com/palhinhax/Athlifyr/commit/c0a61b495d176365a427d5be242601bf6b67f74f))
- **instagram:** optimize video export with adaptive bitrate and FPS ([b4f568b](https://github.com/palhinhax/Athlifyr/commit/b4f568b2b1c854ebe79b41eab66c5edc6d89f09c))

### BREAKING CHANGES

- **i18n:** site.webmanifest now served dynamically via route handler only
- **i18n:** Training plans now require translations in database. Existing plans without translations will need to be migrated.
- **workouts:** Performance entries now only created for exercises with hasWeight=true. Running, burpees, and other bodyweight exercises no longer tracked in strength performance section.
- **db:** StrengthExercise renamed to Exercise. Database migration required.
- **performance:** None - existing RUN entries remain unchanged, only new trail
  events will be classified as TRAIL type.
- **chat:** Socket.IO is no longer used. The custom server.ts
  is removed - use standard 'next start' for production.
- **events:** completionTime field changed from String to Int.
  All existing completion times will be lost during migration.
- **venues:** VenuePlan.paymentProvider field removed. Payment processing now managed at venue level via Venue.paymentMode (IN_APP, EXTERNAL, MIXED).

* Add Stripe Connect onboarding and payment processing for venues
* Create database migration for guest bookings support
* Add Stripe webhook handling for account updates
* Implement venue commission system (PERCENT/FIXED types)
* Add fee management API endpoint and UI dialog (admin only)
* Refactor admin venues page into 5 modular components
* Create venue cards, dialogs for create/owner/fees management
* Add 2 new event seeds: Trail do Vale + Tribal Clash Portugal
* Fix translation structure: move weather inside events namespace
* Fix unused variable ESLint error in image-upload component

New Stripe features:
Venue owner Stripe Connect onboarding
Platform commission configuration per venue
Automated payment splitting
Webhook sync for account status

New admin features:
Fee management modal for venue commissions
Owner assignment dialog with user search
Modular component architecture (195 vs 883 lines)

Database changes:
Guest booking support (userId optional)
PaymentsProvider enum (NONE, STRIPE)
StripeOnboardingStatus tracking
Commission fields (commissionType, commissionValue)
StripeWebhookEvent tracking table

Event seeds:
Trail do Vale 2026 (Tomar, 17 May)
Tribal Clash Portugal 2026 (Vilamoura, 2-3 May)
Complete translations for all 6 languages
SEO metadata with metaTitle/metaDescription
FAQs in all languages

Code quality:
pnpm format passed
ESLint passed (2 warnings only - <img> tags)
TypeScript typecheck passed
All changes follow conventional commits
Documentation created for refactoring

- **seo:** None - improves SEO without breaking existing functionality
- **instagram:** Weather system requires new environment variables:

* OPENWEATHER_API_KEY: API key from openweathermap.org (free tier supported)
* WEATHER_UPDATE_SECRET: Security token for automated updates (generate with openssl rand -hex 32)

Migration required: pnpm prisma migrate dev --name add-event-weather

- **sports:** Events with walking variants should now use WALKING category instead of RUNNING
- **seeds:** Seed files moved from prisma/ to prisma/seeds/ directory.
  Update execution commands to use prisma/seeds/<file>.ts path.
- **instagram:** Database schema updated with new venue and booking models
- **events:** Events page now shows all future events regardless of country by default, instead of filtering by user's country. Users can enable location-based filtering explicitly.
- Seed file relocated from prisma/seed-trail-santa-iria.ts to prisma/seeds/trail-santa-iria-2026.ts

* Move seed file to prisma/seeds/ directory (proper location)
* Remove nested create operations for full idempotency
* Use separate upsert operations for event, translations, variants, and pricing phases
* Add translations for all 6 supported languages (pt, en, es, fr, de, it)
* Add imageUrl field set to empty string
* Add variant translations for all languages
* Safe for execution on shared database environments

Co-authored-by: palhinhax <13228131+palhinhax@users.noreply.github.com>

- **events:** Removed dateRange filter parameter from events API and preferences
- **i18n:** Application now requires locale in URL paths (e.g., /pt/events, /en/events).
  All existing routes have been moved under [locale] folder structure.
- **contact:** New database table Contact requires migration
- **events:** Event model now uses sportTypes[] instead of sportType.
  All existing events automatically migrated to array format.

* Add PricingPhase model for complex pricing structures

* Update all application code to query sportTypes arrays
* Update EventCard to display multiple sport badges
* Migration preserves all existing event data safely

* Build passes with zero errors

- **instagram:** optimize video export with adaptive bitrate and FPS ([b4f568b](https://github.com/palhinhax/Athlifyr/commit/b4f568b2b1c854ebe79b41eab66c5edc6d89f09c))

### BREAKING CHANGES

- **i18n:** site.webmanifest now served dynamically via route handler only
- **i18n:** Training plans now require translations in database. Existing plans without translations will need to be migrated.
- **workouts:** Performance entries now only created for exercises with hasWeight=true. Running, burpees, and other bodyweight exercises no longer tracked in strength performance section.
- **db:** StrengthExercise renamed to Exercise. Database migration required.
- **performance:** None - existing RUN entries remain unchanged, only new trail
  events will be classified as TRAIL type.
- **chat:** Socket.IO is no longer used. The custom server.ts
  is removed - use standard 'next start' for production.
- **events:** completionTime field changed from String to Int.
  All existing completion times will be lost during migration.
- **venues:** VenuePlan.paymentProvider field removed. Payment processing now managed at venue level via Venue.paymentMode (IN_APP, EXTERNAL, MIXED).

* Add Stripe Connect onboarding and payment processing for venues
* Create database migration for guest bookings support
* Add Stripe webhook handling for account updates
* Implement venue commission system (PERCENT/FIXED types)
* Add fee management API endpoint and UI dialog (admin only)
* Refactor admin venues page into 5 modular components
* Create venue cards, dialogs for create/owner/fees management
* Add 2 new event seeds: Trail do Vale + Tribal Clash Portugal
* Fix translation structure: move weather inside events namespace
* Fix unused variable ESLint error in image-upload component

New Stripe features:
Venue owner Stripe Connect onboarding
Platform commission configuration per venue
Automated payment splitting
Webhook sync for account status

New admin features:
Fee management modal for venue commissions
Owner assignment dialog with user search
Modular component architecture (195 vs 883 lines)

Database changes:
Guest booking support (userId optional)
PaymentsProvider enum (NONE, STRIPE)
StripeOnboardingStatus tracking
Commission fields (commissionType, commissionValue)
StripeWebhookEvent tracking table

Event seeds:
Trail do Vale 2026 (Tomar, 17 May)
Tribal Clash Portugal 2026 (Vilamoura, 2-3 May)
Complete translations for all 6 languages
SEO metadata with metaTitle/metaDescription
FAQs in all languages

Code quality:
pnpm format passed
ESLint passed (2 warnings only - <img> tags)
TypeScript typecheck passed
All changes follow conventional commits
Documentation created for refactoring

- **seo:** None - improves SEO without breaking existing functionality
- **instagram:** Weather system requires new environment variables:

* OPENWEATHER_API_KEY: API key from openweathermap.org (free tier supported)
* WEATHER_UPDATE_SECRET: Security token for automated updates (generate with openssl rand -hex 32)

Migration required: pnpm prisma migrate dev --name add-event-weather

- **sports:** Events with walking variants should now use WALKING category instead of RUNNING
- **seeds:** Seed files moved from prisma/ to prisma/seeds/ directory.
  Update execution commands to use prisma/seeds/<file>.ts path.
- **instagram:** Database schema updated with new venue and booking models
- **events:** Events page now shows all future events regardless of country by default, instead of filtering by user's country. Users can enable location-based filtering explicitly.
- Seed file relocated from prisma/seed-trail-santa-iria.ts to prisma/seeds/trail-santa-iria-2026.ts

* Move seed file to prisma/seeds/ directory (proper location)
* Remove nested create operations for full idempotency
* Use separate upsert operations for event, translations, variants, and pricing phases
* Add translations for all 6 supported languages (pt, en, es, fr, de, it)
* Add imageUrl field set to empty string
* Add variant translations for all languages
* Safe for execution on shared database environments

Co-authored-by: palhinhax <13228131+palhinhax@users.noreply.github.com>

- **events:** Removed dateRange filter parameter from events API and preferences
- **i18n:** Application now requires locale in URL paths (e.g., /pt/events, /en/events).
  All existing routes have been moved under [locale] folder structure.
- **contact:** New database table Contact requires migration
- **events:** Event model now uses sportTypes[] instead of sportType.
  All existing events automatically migrated to array format.

* Update all application code to query sportTypes arrays
* Update EventCard to display multiple sport badges
* Migration preserves all existing event data safely

* Build passes with zero errors

### BREAKING CHANGES

- **i18n:** site.webmanifest now served dynamically via route handler only
- **i18n:** Training plans now require translations in database. Existing plans without translations will need to be migrated.
- **workouts:** Performance entries now only created for exercises with hasWeight=true. Running, burpees, and other bodyweight exercises no longer tracked in strength performance section.
- **db:** StrengthExercise renamed to Exercise. Database migration required.
- **performance:** None - existing RUN entries remain unchanged, only new trail
  events will be classified as TRAIL type.
- **chat:** Socket.IO is no longer used. The custom server.ts
  is removed - use standard 'next start' for production.
- **events:** completionTime field changed from String to Int.
  All existing completion times will be lost during migration.
- **venues:** VenuePlan.paymentProvider field removed. Payment processing now managed at venue level via Venue.paymentMode (IN_APP, EXTERNAL, MIXED).

* Add Stripe Connect onboarding and payment processing for venues
* Create database migration for guest bookings support
* Add Stripe webhook handling for account updates
* Implement venue commission system (PERCENT/FIXED types)
* Add fee management API endpoint and UI dialog (admin only)
* Refactor admin venues page into 5 modular components
* Create venue cards, dialogs for create/owner/fees management
* Add 2 new event seeds: Trail do Vale + Tribal Clash Portugal
* Fix translation structure: move weather inside events namespace
* Fix unused variable ESLint error in image-upload component

New Stripe features:
Venue owner Stripe Connect onboarding
Platform commission configuration per venue
Automated payment splitting
Webhook sync for account status

New admin features:
Fee management modal for venue commissions
Owner assignment dialog with user search
Modular component architecture (195 vs 883 lines)

Database changes:
Guest booking support (userId optional)
PaymentsProvider enum (NONE, STRIPE)
StripeOnboardingStatus tracking
Commission fields (commissionType, commissionValue)
StripeWebhookEvent tracking table

Event seeds:
Trail do Vale 2026 (Tomar, 17 May)
Tribal Clash Portugal 2026 (Vilamoura, 2-3 May)
Complete translations for all 6 languages
SEO metadata with metaTitle/metaDescription
FAQs in all languages

Code quality:
pnpm format passed
ESLint passed (2 warnings only - <img> tags)
TypeScript typecheck passed
All changes follow conventional commits
Documentation created for refactoring

- **seo:** None - improves SEO without breaking existing functionality
- **instagram:** Weather system requires new environment variables:

* OPENWEATHER_API_KEY: API key from openweathermap.org (free tier supported)
* WEATHER_UPDATE_SECRET: Security token for automated updates (generate with openssl rand -hex 32)

Migration required: pnpm prisma migrate dev --name add-event-weather

- **sports:** Events with walking variants should now use WALKING category instead of RUNNING
- **seeds:** Seed files moved from prisma/ to prisma/seeds/ directory.
  Update execution commands to use prisma/seeds/<file>.ts path.
- **instagram:** Database schema updated with new venue and booking models
- **events:** Events page now shows all future events regardless of country by default, instead of filtering by user's country. Users can enable location-based filtering explicitly.
- Seed file relocated from prisma/seed-trail-santa-iria.ts to prisma/seeds/trail-santa-iria-2026.ts

* Move seed file to prisma/seeds/ directory (proper location)
* Remove nested create operations for full idempotency
* Use separate upsert operations for event, translations, variants, and pricing phases
* Add translations for all 6 supported languages (pt, en, es, fr, de, it)
* Add imageUrl field set to empty string
* Add variant translations for all languages
* Safe for execution on shared database environments

Co-authored-by: palhinhax <13228131+palhinhax@users.noreply.github.com>

- **events:** Removed dateRange filter parameter from events API and preferences

  All existing routes have been moved under [locale] folder structure.

- **events:** Event model now uses sportTypes[] instead of sportType.
  All existing events automatically migrated to array format.

- **instagram:** optimize video export with adaptive bitrate and FPS ([b4f568b](https://github.com/palhinhax/Athlifyr/commit/b4f568b2b1c854ebe79b41eab66c5edc6d89f09c))

### BREAKING CHANGES

- **i18n:** site.webmanifest now served dynamically via route handler only
- **i18n:** Training plans now require translations in database. Existing plans without translations will need to be migrated.
- **workouts:** Performance entries now only created for exercises with hasWeight=true. Running, burpees, and other bodyweight exercises no longer tracked in strength performance section.
- **db:** StrengthExercise renamed to Exercise. Database migration required.
- **performance:** None - existing RUN entries remain unchanged, only new trail
  events will be classified as TRAIL type.
- **chat:** Socket.IO is no longer used. The custom server.ts
  is removed - use standard 'next start' for production.
- **events:** completionTime field changed from String to Int.
  All existing completion times will be lost during migration.
- **venues:** VenuePlan.paymentProvider field removed. Payment processing now managed at venue level via Venue.paymentMode (IN_APP, EXTERNAL, MIXED).

* Add Stripe Connect onboarding and payment processing for venues
* Create database migration for guest bookings support
* Add Stripe webhook handling for account updates
* Implement venue commission system (PERCENT/FIXED types)
* Add fee management API endpoint and UI dialog (admin only)
* Refactor admin venues page into 5 modular components
* Create venue cards, dialogs for create/owner/fees management
* Add 2 new event seeds: Trail do Vale + Tribal Clash Portugal
* Fix translation structure: move weather inside events namespace
* Fix unused variable ESLint error in image-upload component

New Stripe features:
Venue owner Stripe Connect onboarding
Platform commission configuration per venue
Automated payment splitting
Webhook sync for account status

New admin features:
Fee management modal for venue commissions
Owner assignment dialog with user search
Modular component architecture (195 vs 883 lines)

Database changes:
Guest booking support (userId optional)
PaymentsProvider enum (NONE, STRIPE)
StripeOnboardingStatus tracking
Commission fields (commissionType, commissionValue)
StripeWebhookEvent tracking table

Event seeds:
Trail do Vale 2026 (Tomar, 17 May)
Tribal Clash Portugal 2026 (Vilamoura, 2-3 May)
Complete translations for all 6 languages
SEO metadata with metaTitle/metaDescription
FAQs in all languages

Code quality:
pnpm format passed
ESLint passed (2 warnings only - <img> tags)
TypeScript typecheck passed
All changes follow conventional commits
Documentation created for refactoring

- **seo:** None - improves SEO without breaking existing functionality
- **instagram:** Weather system requires new environment variables:

* OPENWEATHER_API_KEY: API key from openweathermap.org (free tier supported)
* WEATHER_UPDATE_SECRET: Security token for automated updates (generate with openssl rand -hex 32)

Migration required: pnpm prisma migrate dev --name add-event-weather

- **sports:** Events with walking variants should now use WALKING category instead of RUNNING

- Seed file relocated from prisma/seed-trail-santa-iria.ts to prisma/seeds/trail-santa-iria-2026.ts

* Move seed file to prisma/seeds/ directory (proper location)
* Remove nested create operations for full idempotency
* Use separate upsert operations for event, translations, variants, and pricing phases
* Add translations for all 6 supported languages (pt, en, es, fr, de, it)
* Add imageUrl field set to empty string
* Add variant translations for all languages
* Safe for execution on shared database environments

- **events:** Removed dateRange filter parameter from events API and preferences

  All existing routes have been moved under [locale] folder structure.
- **contact:** New database table Contact requires migration
- **events:** Event model now uses sportTypes[] instead of sportType.
  All existing events automatically migrated to array format.

### Performance Improvements

- **admin:** add dedicated admin events endpoint ([38050df](https://github.com/palhinhax/Athlifyr/commit/38050df1147864fd9a3d02983416296ea8b00bb0))
- **admin:** optimize event search performance ([ee1ae5c](https://github.com/palhinhax/Athlifyr/commit/ee1ae5c279d583ca02022e2db97dbbb609d5207e))

- **instagram:** optimize video export with adaptive bitrate and FPS ([b4f568b](https://github.com/palhinhax/Athlifyr/commit/b4f568b2b1c854ebe79b41eab66c5edc6d89f09c))

### BREAKING CHANGES

- **i18n:** site.webmanifest now served dynamically via route handler only
- **i18n:** Training plans now require translations in database. Existing plans without translations will need to be migrated.
- **workouts:** Performance entries now only created for exercises with hasWeight=true. Running, burpees, and other bodyweight exercises no longer tracked in strength performance section.
- **db:** StrengthExercise renamed to Exercise. Database migration required.
- **performance:** None - existing RUN entries remain unchanged, only new trail
  events will be classified as TRAIL type.
- **chat:** Socket.IO is no longer used. The custom server.ts
  is removed - use standard 'next start' for production.
- **events:** completionTime field changed from String to Int.
  All existing completion times will be lost during migration.
- **venues:** VenuePlan.paymentProvider field removed. Payment processing now managed at venue level via Venue.paymentMode (IN_APP, EXTERNAL, MIXED).

* Add Stripe Connect onboarding and payment processing for venues
* Create database migration for guest bookings support
* Add Stripe webhook handling for account updates
* Implement venue commission system (PERCENT/FIXED types)
* Add fee management API endpoint and UI dialog (admin only)
* Refactor admin venues page into 5 modular components
* Create venue cards, dialogs for create/owner/fees management
* Add 2 new event seeds: Trail do Vale + Tribal Clash Portugal
* Fix translation structure: move weather inside events namespace
* Fix unused variable ESLint error in image-upload component

New Stripe features:
Venue owner Stripe Connect onboarding
Platform commission configuration per venue
Automated payment splitting
Webhook sync for account status

New admin features:
Fee management modal for venue commissions
Owner assignment dialog with user search
Modular component architecture (195 vs 883 lines)

Database changes:
Guest booking support (userId optional)
PaymentsProvider enum (NONE, STRIPE)
StripeOnboardingStatus tracking
Commission fields (commissionType, commissionValue)
StripeWebhookEvent tracking table

Event seeds:
Trail do Vale 2026 (Tomar, 17 May)
Tribal Clash Portugal 2026 (Vilamoura, 2-3 May)
Complete translations for all 6 languages
SEO metadata with metaTitle/metaDescription
FAQs in all languages

Code quality:
pnpm format passed
ESLint passed (2 warnings only - <img> tags)
TypeScript typecheck passed
All changes follow conventional commits
Documentation created for refactoring

- **seo:** None - improves SEO without breaking existing functionality
- **instagram:** Weather system requires new environment variables:

* OPENWEATHER_API_KEY: API key from openweathermap.org (free tier supported)
* WEATHER_UPDATE_SECRET: Security token for automated updates (generate with openssl rand -hex 32)

Migration required: pnpm prisma migrate dev --name add-event-weather

- **sports:** Events with walking variants should now use WALKING category instead of RUNNING
- **seeds:** Seed files moved from prisma/ to prisma/seeds/ directory.
  Update execution commands to use prisma/seeds/<file>.ts path.
- **instagram:** Database schema updated with new venue and booking models
- **events:** Events page now shows all future events regardless of country by default, instead of filtering by user's country. Users can enable location-based filtering explicitly.
- Seed file relocated from prisma/seed-trail-santa-iria.ts to prisma/seeds/trail-santa-iria-2026.ts

* Move seed file to prisma/seeds/ directory (proper location)
* Remove nested create operations for full idempotency
* Use separate upsert operations for event, translations, variants, and pricing phases
* Add translations for all 6 supported languages (pt, en, es, fr, de, it)
* Add imageUrl field set to empty string
* Add variant translations for all languages
* Safe for execution on shared database environments

Co-authored-by: palhinhax <13228131+palhinhax@users.noreply.github.com>

- **events:** Removed dateRange filter parameter from events API and preferences
- **i18n:** Application now requires locale in URL paths (e.g., /pt/events, /en/events).
  All existing routes have been moved under [locale] folder structure.
- **contact:** New database table Contact requires migration
- **events:** Event model now uses sportTypes[] instead of sportType.
  All existing events automatically migrated to array format.

* Add PricingPhase model for complex pricing structures

* Build passes with zero errors

### Performance Improvements

- **admin:** add dedicated admin events endpoint ([38050df](https://github.com/palhinhax/Athlifyr/commit/38050df1147864fd9a3d02983416296ea8b00bb0))
- **admin:** optimize event search performance ([ee1ae5c](https://github.com/palhinhax/Athlifyr/commit/ee1ae5c279d583ca02022e2db97dbbb609d5207e))
- **api:** optimize event update endpoint to only modify changed data ([c0a61b4](https://github.com/palhinhax/Athlifyr/commit/c0a61b495d176365a427d5be242601bf6b67f74f))
- **instagram:** optimize video export with adaptive bitrate and FPS ([b4f568b](https://github.com/palhinhax/Athlifyr/commit/b4f568b2b1c854ebe79b41eab66c5edc6d89f09c))

### BREAKING CHANGES

- **i18n:** site.webmanifest now served dynamically via route handler only
- **i18n:** Training plans now require translations in database. Existing plans without translations will need to be migrated.
- **workouts:** Performance entries now only created for exercises with hasWeight=true. Running, burpees, and other bodyweight exercises no longer tracked in strength performance section.
- **db:** StrengthExercise renamed to Exercise. Database migration required.
- **performance:** None - existing RUN entries remain unchanged, only new trail
  events will be classified as TRAIL type.
- **chat:** Socket.IO is no longer used. The custom server.ts
  is removed - use standard 'next start' for production.
- **events:** completionTime field changed from String to Int.
  All existing completion times will be lost during migration.
- **venues:** VenuePlan.paymentProvider field removed. Payment processing now managed at venue level via Venue.paymentMode (IN_APP, EXTERNAL, MIXED).

* Add Stripe Connect onboarding and payment processing for venues
* Create database migration for guest bookings support
* Add Stripe webhook handling for account updates
* Implement venue commission system (PERCENT/FIXED types)
* Add fee management API endpoint and UI dialog (admin only)
* Refactor admin venues page into 5 modular components
* Create venue cards, dialogs for create/owner/fees management
* Add 2 new event seeds: Trail do Vale + Tribal Clash Portugal
* Fix translation structure: move weather inside events namespace
* Fix unused variable ESLint error in image-upload component

New Stripe features:
Venue owner Stripe Connect onboarding
Platform commission configuration per venue
Automated payment splitting
Webhook sync for account status

New admin features:
Fee management modal for venue commissions
Owner assignment dialog with user search
Modular component architecture (195 vs 883 lines)

Database changes:
Guest booking support (userId optional)
PaymentsProvider enum (NONE, STRIPE)
StripeOnboardingStatus tracking
Commission fields (commissionType, commissionValue)
StripeWebhookEvent tracking table

Event seeds:
Trail do Vale 2026 (Tomar, 17 May)
Tribal Clash Portugal 2026 (Vilamoura, 2-3 May)
Complete translations for all 6 languages
SEO metadata with metaTitle/metaDescription
FAQs in all languages

Code quality:
pnpm format passed
ESLint passed (2 warnings only - <img> tags)
TypeScript typecheck passed
All changes follow conventional commits
Documentation created for refactoring

- **seo:** None - improves SEO without breaking existing functionality
- **instagram:** Weather system requires new environment variables:

* OPENWEATHER_API_KEY: API key from openweathermap.org (free tier supported)
* WEATHER_UPDATE_SECRET: Security token for automated updates (generate with openssl rand -hex 32)

Migration required: pnpm prisma migrate dev --name add-event-weather

- **sports:** Events with walking variants should now use WALKING category instead of RUNNING
- **seeds:** Seed files moved from prisma/ to prisma/seeds/ directory.
  Update execution commands to use prisma/seeds/<file>.ts path.
- **instagram:** Database schema updated with new venue and booking models
- **events:** Events page now shows all future events regardless of country by default, instead of filtering by user's country. Users can enable location-based filtering explicitly.
- Seed file relocated from prisma/seed-trail-santa-iria.ts to prisma/seeds/trail-santa-iria-2026.ts

* Move seed file to prisma/seeds/ directory (proper location)
* Remove nested create operations for full idempotency
* Use separate upsert operations for event, translations, variants, and pricing phases
* Add translations for all 6 supported languages (pt, en, es, fr, de, it)
* Add imageUrl field set to empty string
* Add variant translations for all languages
* Safe for execution on shared database environments

Co-authored-by: palhinhax <13228131+palhinhax@users.noreply.github.com>

- **events:** Removed dateRange filter parameter from events API and preferences
- **i18n:** Application now requires locale in URL paths (e.g., /pt/events, /en/events).
  All existing routes have been moved under [locale] folder structure.
- **contact:** New database table Contact requires migration
- **events:** Event model now uses sportTypes[] instead of sportType.
  All existing events automatically migrated to array format.

- **ui:** improve mobile responsiveness and add login icons ([d59954b](https://github.com/palhinhax/Athlifyr/commit/d59954ba8037f56db923da1aebdfe7b87a432d68))
- **venues:** add sessions & services settings tab with complete i18n ([68f726d](https://github.com/palhinhax/Athlifyr/commit/68f726d55c79a53649f6659a7109a1ebdd10bcd0))
- **venues:** add Stripe Connect payments and modularize admin venues page ([e5048df](https://github.com/palhinhax/Athlifyr/commit/e5048dfd28518ec27af131679dea2e7657e75376))

### BREAKING CHANGES

- **performance:** None - existing RUN entries remain unchanged, only new trail
  events will be classified as TRAIL type.
- **chat:** Socket.IO is no longer used. The custom server.ts
  is removed - use standard 'next start' for production.
- **events:** completionTime field changed from String to Int.
  All existing completion times will be lost during migration.
- **venues:** VenuePlan.paymentProvider field removed. Payment processing now managed at venue level via Venue.paymentMode (IN_APP, EXTERNAL, MIXED).

* Add Stripe Connect onboarding and payment processing for venues
* Create database migration for guest bookings support
* Add Stripe webhook handling for account updates
* Implement venue commission system (PERCENT/FIXED types)
* Add fee management API endpoint and UI dialog (admin only)
* Refactor admin venues page into 5 modular components
* Create venue cards, dialogs for create/owner/fees management
* Add 2 new event seeds: Trail do Vale + Tribal Clash Portugal
* Fix translation structure: move weather inside events namespace
* Fix unused variable ESLint error in image-upload component

New Stripe features:
Venue owner Stripe Connect onboarding
Platform commission configuration per venue
Automated payment splitting
Webhook sync for account status

New admin features:
Fee management modal for venue commissions
Owner assignment dialog with user search
Modular component architecture (195 vs 883 lines)

Database changes:
Guest booking support (userId optional)
PaymentsProvider enum (NONE, STRIPE)
StripeOnboardingStatus tracking
Commission fields (commissionType, commissionValue)
StripeWebhookEvent tracking table

Event seeds:
Trail do Vale 2026 (Tomar, 17 May)
Tribal Clash Portugal 2026 (Vilamoura, 2-3 May)
Complete translations for all 6 languages
SEO metadata with metaTitle/metaDescription
FAQs in all languages

Code quality:
pnpm format passed
ESLint passed (2 warnings only - <img> tags)
TypeScript typecheck passed
All changes follow conventional commits
Documentation created for refactoring

# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

## [Unreleased]

### Added

- Location-based event filters with distance radius
- Geolocation support for finding nearby events
- Distance slider (10-500 km range)
- Filter persistence for anonymous users
- Global text search across events
- Complete i18n support for 6 languages (en, pt, es, fr, de, it)
